title: %toObject — build an object from key/value pairs
purpose: Fold an array of [key, value] pairs into a single object keyed by the first element.
notes: Each [key, value] pair becomes a field, rendered as the {.obj} sub-block.
Pairs may also be {key, value} or {k, v} objects; the key is stringified.

avoid.snippet: obj = %toObject @.raw  ; input is a plain string
avoid.why: toObject only accepts arrays; any non-array input silently produces ~ (null)
